data.name: AJ's Anomaly
data.detailed_description:
AJ's Anomaly is a first-person anomaly horror experience. Play as Amelia Jalisco, a fashion designer investigating her gallery the night before a big exhibition. After months of exhausting work and a series of troubled business relationships, she may be starting to lose her mind.

Features:

  • Spot the Difference, Survive the Consequence - Study each room carefully. An object out of place, a light gone dark, a face that wasn't there before - anything can be the anomaly, and getting it wrong has a cost.

  • A Building That Doesn't Follow the Rules - Hidden rooms, shifting layouts, and paths that shouldn't exist wait behind doors that look ordinary until they aren't.

  • Something Else Is Remembering Too - This isn't just AJ's memory to walk through alone. Occasional encounters remind you that not everything here is a static exhibit.

  • A Flashback with Teeth - Uncover the story behind the gallery launch as you get closer to the truth — and further from safety.

  • Story - Amelia Jalisco remembers the night perfectly: The launch of her new clothing line, an exclusive gallery event on the 8th floor of a strange, half-familiar building in South Terrace.

Inspired by The Exit 8 and Captured-style anomaly horror, AJ's Anomaly is a short, tense loop built for one sitting and one lingering unease afterward.

Look closely. Trust nothing. Get out.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 (2GB) / AMD Radeon R9 280 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
